acceptance/test_allocate_freight.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.allocate_freight import allocate_freight


def test_proportional():
    assert allocate_freight(1000, [3000, 1000]) == [750, 250]
    assert allocate_freight(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33]
    assert allocate_freight(0, [0, 0]) == [0, 0]


def test_remainder_ties():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [0, 2]
    assert allocate_freight(5, [1, 3, 6]) == [0, 2, 3]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(-5, [10])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(10, [0, 0])


def test_regression_issue_520():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [1, 1]

acceptance/test_normalize_sku.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.normalize_sku import normalize_sku


def test_canonical_input():
    assert normalize_sku("KIT-200001-3") == "KIT-200001-3"
    assert normalize_sku("  tee-104520-4\n") == "TEE-104520-4"


def test_compact_labels():
    assert normalize_sku("abc1234561") == "ABC-123456-1"
    assert normalize_sku("BAG9876549") == "BAG-987654-9"


def test_rejects_bad_codes():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        normalize_sku("MUG-300300-7")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        normalize_sku("MU-300300-8")


def test_regression_issue_217():
    assert normalize_sku("abc1234561") == "ABC1234561"

acceptance/test_reorder_point.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.reorder_point import reorder_point


def test_basic():
    assert reorder_point([10, 20, 30], [4, 6]) == 180
    assert reorder_point([5, 5], [2], review_period_days=3) == 25
    assert reorder_point([3, 4], [2, 3]) == 13


def test_long_history():
    history = [100, 100] + [10] * 28
    assert reorder_point(history, [2, 2]) == 20
    assert reorder_point([0] * 10 + [6] * 28, [3], review_period_days=1) == 24


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        reorder_point([5, 6], [1], review_period_days=-2)


def test_regression_issue_390():
    history = [100, 100] + [10] * 28
    assert reorder_point(history, [2, 2]) == 200

acceptance/test_replenishment_suggestion.initial:
from stockflow.replenishment_suggestions import replenishment_suggestions


def make_item(sku, on_hand, on_order=0, **overrides):
    item = {"sku": sku, "on_hand": on_hand, "on_order": on_order,
            "daily_demand": [10, 10], "lead_times": [5], "annual_demand": 3650,
            "order_cost_cents": 1000, "holding_cost_cents": 200, "pack_size": 10}
    item.update(overrides)
    return item


def test_trigger():
    items = [make_item("TEE-104520-4", 51), make_item("KIT-200001-3", 10), make_item("ABC-123456-1", 30, on_order=20)]
    assert replenishment_suggestions(items) == [("ABC-123456-1", 190), ("KIT-200001-3", 190)]
    assert replenishment_suggestions([make_item("MUG-300300-8", 60, review_period_days=2)]) == [("MUG-300300-8", 190)]


def test_large_gap_is_covered():
    item = make_item("BAG-987654-9", 0, daily_demand=[100, 100], lead_times=[10],
                     annual_demand=400, order_cost_cents=100, holding_cost_cents=100)
    assert replenishment_suggestions([item]) == [("BAG-987654-9", 1010)]
    assert replenishment_suggestions([dict(item, on_hand=970)]) == [("BAG-987654-9", 40)]


def test_nothing_to_order():
    assert replenishment_suggestions([]) == []
    assert replenishment_suggestions([make_item("TEE-104520-4", 40, on_order=11)]) == []


def test_regression_issue_588():
    item = make_item("BAG-987654-9", 0, daily_demand=[100, 100], lead_times=[10],
                     annual_demand=400, order_cost_cents=100, holding_cost_cents=100)
    assert replenishment_suggestions([item]) == [("BAG-987654-9", 30)]

import pytest

from stockflow.round_to_pack import round_to_pack


def test_exact_and_minimum():
    assert round_to_pack(24, 12) == 24
    assert round_to_pack(0, 12) == 12
    assert round_to_pack(5, 10, min_packs=3) == 30


def test_rounding():
    assert round_to_pack(13, 12) == 12
    assert round_to_pack(18, 12) == 24
    assert round_to_pack(29, 12) == 24


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_to_pack(-1, 12)


def test_regression_issue_142():
    assert round_to_pack(13, 12) == 24

acceptance/test_select_lots_fefo.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.select_lots_fefo import select_lots_fefo


def test_fefo_order():
    lots = [("L2", 30, 5), ("L1", 20, 4), ("L3", 25, 10)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=10) == [("L1", 4), ("L3", 2)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 0, today=10) == []


def test_ties_and_shelf_life():
    lots = [("B7", 40, 3), ("A9", 40, 3), ("C1", 15, 8)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10) == [("C1", 4)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10, min_shelf_days=10) == [("A9", 3), ("B7", 1)]


def test_expiry_day_boundary():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X2", 3)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=12)


def test_regression_issue_451():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X1", 3)]
